title.zh: 逃逸速度与史瓦西半径
title.en: Escape speed and the Schwarzschild radius

description.zh: 质量压得越小逃逸速度越大，压到 rₛ = 2GM/c² 时等于光速；这是启发式算法，真正的视界来自广义相对论。
description.en: Squeeze a mass and its escape speed rises until it reaches c at r_s = 2GM/c²; a heuristic that happens to match the horizon of general relativity.

en: why can't light escape a black hole
how small would Earth be as a black hole

description.zh: 视界半径和质量成正比，按体积平均的“密度”与质量平方成反比：超大质量黑洞可以比水还稀。
description.en: Horizon radius grows in proportion to mass, so mass per volume falls as 1/M²: a supermassive black hole can be less dense than water.

en: how big is a black hole
black hole less dense than water

description.zh: 同样的距离，黑洞的引力和同样重的恒星一样：把太阳换成同质量的黑洞，地球轨道不变。
description.en: At the same distance a black hole pulls like any equal mass: replace the Sun with a one-solar-mass black hole and Earth's orbit does not change.

zh: 黑洞会把东西吸进去吗
en: do black holes suck things in
what if the Sun became a black hole

title.zh: 最内稳定圆轨道与光子球
title.en: Innermost stable orbit and the photon sphere

description.zh: 离黑洞几个 rₛ 以内引力比牛顿说的强：轨道进动，3 rₛ 以内没有稳定圆轨道，1.5 rₛ 处光可以绕圈。
description.en: Within a few r_s gravity is stronger than Newton's: orbits precess, no circular orbit is stable inside 3 r_s, and light can circle at 1.5 r_s.

description.zh: 头脚之间的引力差在视界上与质量平方成反比：小黑洞在视界外就把人撕开，大黑洞可以平安穿过。
description.en: The head-to-foot difference in pull at the horizon falls as 1/M²: small black holes tear you apart outside, large ones let you cross intact.

en: what happens if you fall into a black hole
torn apart by a black hole
can you survive crossing the event horizon

title.zh: 引力时间膨胀与引力红移

description.zh: 悬停在 r 处的钟按 √(1 − rₛ/r) 变慢，越近视界越慢；GPS 卫星每天要为此修正几十微秒。
description.en: A clock hovering at r ticks at √(1 − r_s/r), slower near the horizon; GPS satellites correct for tens of microseconds a day.

en: time slows near a black hole

description.zh: 瞄准中心 2.6 rₛ 以内的光都被吞掉，所以看到的黑影约是视界的 2.6 倍；EHT 拍到的人马座 A* 与之一致。
description.en: Light aimed within 2.6 r_s is captured, so the dark shadow is about 2.6 times the horizon; the EHT image of Sgr A* agrees.

title.zh: 恒星 S2 称出人马座 A*
title.en: Weighing Sgr A* with the star S2

description.zh: S2 绕银河系中心一圈 16 年，开普勒第三定律给出约 426 万个太阳质量挤在约 120 个日地距离以内。
description.en: S2 circles the Galactic Centre every 16 years; Kepler's third law puts about 4.26 million solar masses inside about 120 AU.

zh: 开普勒第三定律 称质量
en: how do we know black holes exist

title.en: Gravitational waves from merging black holes

description.zh: 两个黑洞绕转时辐射引力波、越绕越快，频率上扫成“啁啾”；GW150914 是 36 和 29 个太阳质量的合并。
description.en: Orbiting black holes radiate gravitational waves and spiral in, sweeping up in frequency as a chirp; GW150914 was a 36 + 29 solar-mass merger.

title.zh: 黑洞到底是什么：霍金辐射与本页的边界
title.en: What a black hole is: Hawking radiation and the limits

description.zh: 总结：远看是质量，近看改变轨道、时间和光；霍金辐射对天体黑洞可以忽略，视界以内本页不做断言。
description.en: Summary: from afar just a mass, up close it reshapes orbits, time and light; Hawking radiation is negligible for astrophysical holes, and nothing is claimed about the interior.

en: what is inside a black hole

reason.zh: 第 2 章把第 1 章的史瓦西半径 r_s = 2GM/c² 当作黑洞的大小：r_s 与质量成正比，所以“质量 ÷ 体积”与质量的平方成反比。
reason.en: Chapter 2 takes chapter 1’s Schwarzschild radius r_s = 2GM/c² as the size of the hole: r_s grows in proportion to mass, so mass ÷ volume falls as the square of the mass.

reason.zh: 第 7 章的影子来自第 4 章的光子球：光在 1.5 r_s 处可以绕圈，瞄得比 2.6 r_s 更近的光线都被吞掉，所以影子比视界大。
reason.en: Chapter 7’s shadow comes from chapter 4’s photon sphere: light can circle at 1.5 r_s, every ray aimed closer than 2.6 r_s is captured, so the shadow is larger than the horizon.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的啁啾模型在最内稳定圆轨道（第 4 章的 3 r_s）对应的频率处停下，之后是合并，不再用这个公式。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s chirp model stops at the frequency of the innermost stable circular orbit (chapter 4’s 3 r_s); after that comes the merger, which the formula does not cover.

label.en: Universal gravitation and the shell theorem

reason.zh: 第 3 章把太阳换成同质量的黑洞，地球的一年仍是 365.3 天：对外面的东西，球对称的物体就像质量集中在中心一点；轨道规则本身见“万有引力与轨道”第 1 步。
reason.en: Chapter 3 swaps the Sun for a black hole of the same mass and the year stays 365.3 days: to things outside, a spherical body acts as a point mass; the rules of orbits are on Gravity and Orbits, step 1.

reason.zh: 第 6 章算 GPS 卫星钟：引力弱让它每天快 45.7 微秒，按狭义相对论速度又让它慢 7.2 微秒，合计约快 38 微秒；速度项引用狭义相对论页。
reason.en: Chapter 6 works out the GPS clock: weaker gravity makes it gain 45.7 μs a day, special relativity makes it lose 7.2 μs a day for its speed, about 38 μs net; the speed term points to the Special Relativity page.

reason.zh: 第 7 章说：离得远时光只弯一点，正是引力透镜页讲的范围；靠近黑洞时弯得厉害到能绕圈，才有影子。
reason.en: Chapter 7: far away light bends only slightly, the range the Gravitational Lensing page covers; close to a black hole it bends enough to circle, which makes the shadow.
